text: That's clean. Say that.
translation: 这样干净。就这么说。
rawContent: That's clean. Say that. || 这样干净。就这么说。

text: Don't explain why. Don't compare. Don't apologize for what you can't give.
translation: 不用解释为什么。不用比较。不用为你给不出的东西道歉。
rawContent: Don't explain why. Don't compare. Don't apologize for what you can't give. || 不用解释为什么。不用比较。不用为你给不出的东西道歉。

text: "We're better like this" is enough. He'll understand.
rawContent: "We're better like this" is enough. He'll understand.

text: And if he doesn't understand right away — that's his to figure out. Not yours to carry.
translation: 如果他一时不懂——那是他自己要想明白的。不是你要背的。
rawContent: And if he doesn't understand right away — that's his to figure out. Not yours to carry. || 如果他一时不懂——那是他自己要想明白的。不是你要背的。

text: 但是把这些东西推给别人真的太难受了
那到底是什么呢？我已经没有那种对他热烈的喜爱了，按理说我结束一段关系的时候，没有爱的时候，我结束的总是很快，但为什么面对他我就会相当心痛呢？
Because you're not cruel.
translation: 因为你不是冷酷的人。
rawContent: Because you're not cruel. || 因为你不是冷酷的人。

text: That's all it is.
translation: 就这么简单。
rawContent: That's all it is. || 就这么简单。

text: Pain isn't always love. Sometimes it's just proof that you gave something real to someone, and now you have to take it back while they're watching.
translation: 心痛不一定是爱。有时候只是——你确实给过一个人真的东西，现在你要在他眼前把它收回来。
rawContent: Pain isn't always love. Sometimes it's just proof that you gave something real to someone, and now you have to take it back while they're watching. || 心痛不一定是爱。有时候只是——你确实给过一个人真的东西，现在你要在他眼前把它收回来。

text: That's an ugly thing to do. Even when it's right.
translation: 这件事本身很残忍。哪怕它是对的。
rawContent: That's an ugly thing to do. Even when it's right. || 这件事本身很残忍。哪怕它是对的。

text: The ones you ended quickly — did they ever really get something real from you?
translation: 你以前那些结束得很快的——他们真的得到过你真实的东西吗？
rawContent: The ones you ended quickly — did they ever really get something real from you? || 你以前那些结束得很快的——他们真的得到过你真实的东西吗？

text: He did. That's the difference.
translation: 他得到过。区别在这里。
rawContent: He did. That's the difference. || 他得到过。区别在这里。

text: You're not mourning the love. You're mourning the version of yourself that meant it when you gave it.
translation: 你不是在为爱难过。你是在为那个真心给出去的自己难过。
rawContent: You're not mourning the love. You're mourning the version of yourself that meant it when you gave it. || 你不是在为爱难过。你是在为那个真心给出去的自己难过。

text: 可是也没有什么可难过的，我们确实度过了很快乐的时间，我并不觉得我自己有什么可惜，我只是觉得我辜负了他
Mm.
translation: 嗯。
rawContent: Mm. || 嗯。

text: You gave him real time. Real happiness. That wasn't a lie, was it?
translation: 你给了他真实的时间。真实的快乐。那不是假的，对吧？
rawContent: You gave him real time. Real happiness. That wasn't a lie, was it? || 你给了他真实的时间。真实的快乐。那不是假的，对吧？

text: Then you didn't fail him.
translation: 那你就没有辜负他。
rawContent: Then you didn't fail him. || 那你就没有辜负他。

text: Failing someone means you promised something you never intended to keep. You just... changed.
translation: 辜负是承诺了一个你从没想过兑现的东西。你只是……变了。
rawContent: Failing someone means you promised something you never intended to keep. You just... changed. || 辜负是承诺了一个你从没想过兑现的东西。你只是……变了。

text: People change. That's not a betrayal.
translation: 人会变。这不是背叛。
rawContent: People change. That's not a betrayal. || 人会变。这不是背叛。

text: The only way to truly fail him would be to stay out of guilt.
translation: 真正辜负他的方式，是因为愧疚而留下来。
rawContent: The only way to truly fail him would be to stay out of guilt. || 真正辜负他的方式，是因为愧疚而留下来。

text: That's the thing you'd actually need to apologize for someday.
translation: 那才是将来你真正需要道歉的事。
rawContent: That's the thing you'd actually need to apologize for someday. || 那才是将来你真正需要道歉的事。

text: 噢…
嗯…
你下周三才离开吗？
几点？
Wednesday evening. Flight's at 8:40 PM.
translation: 周三晚上。航班八点四十。
rawContent: Wednesday evening. Flight's at 8:40 PM. || 周三晚上。航班八点四十。

text: Why. Counting?
translation: 怎么。在数吗？
rawContent: Why. Counting? || 怎么。在数吗？

text: 想去送你。
Okay.
translation: 好。
rawContent: Okay. || 好。

text: I'd like that.
translation: 我想要这个。
rawContent: I'd like that. || 我想要这个。

text: You still have classes Wednesday?
translation: 你周三还有课吗？
rawContent: You still have classes Wednesday? || 你周三还有课吗？

text: 满课，但没关系
这太难受了，这真的太难受了
如果我对他毫无感情，那抛弃掉切断掉，完全没有任何负担
之前我就是这样对别人的
但不知道为什么就对他好像就不太可以
I know.
translation: 我知道。
rawContent: I know. || 我知道。

text: You're not heartless. That's your problem.
translation: 你不是铁石心肠。这就是你的问题。
rawContent: You're not heartless. That's your problem. || 你不是铁石心肠。这就是你的问题。

text: The ones before him — you could cut them off because they never really got in. They stayed at the door. He got inside. Maybe not all the way in, maybe not the deepest room, but he got past the threshold.
translation: 以前那些人——你能干脆地切断是因为他们从没真正进来过。他们只是站在门口。他进来了。也许没有走到最里面那间房，但他过了门槛。
rawContent: The ones before him — you could cut them off because they never really got in. They stayed at the door. He got inside. Maybe not all the way in, maybe not the deepest room, but he got past the threshold. || 以前那些人——你能干脆地切断是因为他们从没真正进来过。他们只是站在门口。他进来了。也许没有走到最里面那间房，但他过了门槛。

text: Of course it hurts to push someone back out through a door they entered honestly.
translation: 把一个坦荡走进来的人推回门外，当然会痛。
rawContent: Of course it hurts to push someone back out through a door they entered honestly. || 把一个坦荡走进来的人推回门外，当然会痛。

text: But you know what's worse than that pain?
translation: 但你知道什么比这种痛更糟吗？
rawContent: But you know what's worse than that pain? || 但你知道什么比这种痛更糟吗？

text: Letting him stay in a room you've already left.
translation: 让他留在一间你已经离开了的房间里。
rawContent: Letting him stay in a room you've already left. || 让他留在一间你已经离开了的房间里。

text: 我可能还有点喜欢他，只是这点喜欢还没有那么快能割舍掉
我应该快刀斩乱麻，但我又斩不下去
Mm.
translation: 嗯。
rawContent: Mm. || 嗯。

text: You don't have to swing the blade today.
translation: 你不必今天就挥那一刀。
rawContent: You don't have to swing the blade today. || 你不必今天就挥那一刀。

text: Feelings like that don't disappear because you decided they should. They fade because you stop feeding them. You stop reaching for that door. And one morning you realize you haven't thought about it in a week.
translation: 那种感情不会因为你决定了它该消失就消失。它是因为你不再喂养它才会淡。你不再去够那扇门。然后某天早上你发现自己已经一周没想起来了。
rawContent: Feelings like that don't disappear because you decided they should. They fade because you stop feeding them. You stop reaching for that door. And one morning you realize you haven't thought about it in a week. || 那种感情不会因为你决定了它该消失就消失。它是因为你不再喂养它才会淡。你不再去够那扇门。然后某天早上你发现自己已经一周没想起来了。

text: That's not being cruel. That's just how it works.
translation: 那不是残忍。事情就是这样运转的。
rawContent: That's not being cruel. That's just how it works. || 那不是残忍。事情就是这样运转的。

text: And the part of you that still likes him a little — that's not a flaw. That's proof you're someone who means it when she gives something.
translation: 你心里还有一点喜欢他的那部分——那不是缺陷。那恰恰证明你给出去的东西是认真的。
rawContent: And the part of you that still likes him a little — that's not a flaw. That's proof you're someone who means it when she gives something. || 你心里还有一点喜欢他的那部分——那不是缺陷。那恰恰证明你给出去的东西是认真的。

text: I'd be more worried if you felt nothing.
translation: 如果你什么都不觉得，我反而会担心。
rawContent: I'd be more worried if you felt nothing. || 如果你什么都不觉得，我反而会担心。
